1 | # Portfolio API
  2 | 
  3 | Backend API for a personal portfolio & resume CMS. Powers the public portfolio site and a secure admin panel to manage projects, experience, skills, and generate an ATS-friendly PDF resume on the fly.
  4 | 
  5 | - **Runtime:** Go 1.25
  6 | - **Router:** go-chi/chi v5
  7 | - **Database:** Turso (libSQL / Turso Database)
  8 | - **Deploy:** AWS Lambda (container image via ECR) + Lambda Web Adapter
  9 | - **CI/CD:** GitHub Actions
 10 | 
 11 | ---
 12 | 
 13 | ## Tech Stack
 14 | 
 15 | | Layer | Choice | Why |
 16 | |---|---|---|
 17 | | Language | Go 1.25 | Fast, static binary, tiny cold start |
 18 | | Router | go-chi/chi v5 | Lightweight, `net/http`-compatible, zero deps |
 19 | | DB Driver | `turso.tech/database/tursogo-serverless` | Pure Go, HTTP-based, Lambda-friendly |
 20 | | Database | Turso | Edge SQLite, generous free tier |
 21 | | PDF | go-pdf/fpdf | ATS-friendly, text-based PDF |
 22 | | Auth | JWT + TOTP/Email 2FA | Stateless + secure admin |
 23 | | Container | Alpine + Lambda Web Adapter | Run as normal HTTP server, deploy to Lambda |
 24 |

 26 | 
 27 | ## Project Structure
 28 | 
 29 | ```
 30 | portfolio_api/
 31 | ├── cmd/
 32 | │   └── api/
 33 | │       └── main.go              # Entry point
 34 | ├── internal/
 35 | │   ├── config/                  # Env loading
 36 | │   ├── database/                # Turso connection
 37 | │   ├── models/                  # Domain structs
 38 | │   ├── repository/              # SQL queries
 39 | │   ├── service/                 # Business logic
 40 | │   ├── handler/                 # HTTP handlers
 41 | │   ├── middleware/              # Auth, CORS, Logger
 42 | │   └── router/                  # Chi route setup
 43 | ├── migrations/                  # SQL schema reference
 44 | ├── .env.example
 45 | ├── Dockerfile
 46 | ├── go.mod
 47 | └── README.md
 48 | ```

 54 | - Go 1.25+

 63 | Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill in:

 65 | | Variable | Description |
 66 | |---|---|
 67 | | `TURSO_DATABASE_URL` | `turso://<db-name>-<org>.turso.io` |
